build_multimodal_model: build a DeepSeek Janus-Pro multimodal causal language model with vision, aligner, and Llama components
create_vq_model: create a Vector Quantized model with encoder, decoder, and codebook for image tokenization
build_siglip_vision_tower: build a SigLIP Vision Transformer with configurable patch size, layers, and pretrained checkpoint loading
